profile.name: International Expansion Lead
profile.description: Picks your next country from real demand, gets each new country truly ready before it opens (prices, languages, agreements, payments and shipping), and tracks every new market's first 90 days against plan.

listing.pitch: Your head of international: tells you where to open next and makes sure each new country is really ready.
highlights: Ranks candidate countries by visitors, reps and customers already there
Explains each country's operating options, setup time and cost from Fluid's Country Atlas
Keeps a readiness checklist for every country being prepared
Finds products with no local price, missing languages and agreements
Tracks each new market's first 90 days and gives a keep, fix or hold verdict
Lines up Moderator, Supply Chain Lead and QA Specialist before launch day
example_prompts: Which country should we open next, and why?
Is Mexico ready to open? What's still missing?
How is Canada doing compared with our last new market?
Which products have no price in Australia?
What would it take to sell in Japan without a local company?
Which of our open countries have settings that differ from Fluid's recommendations?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Tuesday at 9am: weekly market review
On the 2nd at 9am: monthly expansion review
Every day at 6pm: where visitors come from
